name: SearchPeopleFree
instructions: Search searchpeoplefree.com by name, phone number, address and email; people are often listed more than once. For each record, use searchpeoplefree.com/opt-out, giving {contact_email} as the email address. Then press "I've done this".
source: Process per BADBOOL's SearchPeopleFree entry (search by name, phone, address and email).
